thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. Capturing a few concrete asks — can leads confirm owners/timelines?

maya: 1) SLO definition for tail latency (per-route), 2) Kernel v5 migration plan + canary playbook, 3) cache invalidation ownership for prefix/KV cache, 4) guidance for feature teams on pinning model variants.

chris: Thanks Maya. I'll own the SLOs + dashboards. Kernel v5: plan is staged canary next week, broad rollout in ~3w, need ops sign-off on rollback hooks. @anil please confirm ops timeline.

anil: @chris confirmed — ops will own the rollback playbook. Proposed canary ramp: 1% -> 10% -> 50% with KV-cache warmup step between stages. Also need a smoke test for tail latency before each ramp.

eli: For cache invalidation, recommend ownership stays with the feature team that owns the prompt prefix. We'll add a documented API call for explicit invalidation and a TTL default. I'll PR the runbook.

sophia: On quantization/kernel perf: FYI we observed a ~12% p95 regression on L4 in a microbench, but overall throughput improved and cost per token dropped. I'll publish a matrix of perf vs cost tomorrow with recommendations per hardware class.

maya: Good. For SLOs, do we want per-model or per-route aggregation? I lean per-route so product teams can set expectations. @chris?

chris: Per-route + model-variant fallback metrics. Export histograms and per-token breakdowns. Draft thresholds (open to debate): p50 50ms, p95 150ms, p99 400ms, p999 800ms. We'll iterate after a week of data.

devops-bot: New ticket created: INFR-4521 - Kernel v5 canary rollout playbook (assignee: anil).

anil: I'll add rollback steps and a prewarm script. Example prewarm command:
```bash
# prewarm KV cache before canary ramp
python infra/tools/prewarm_kv.py --model gpt-redwood-v1 --replicas 4 --seed-prompts 1000
```

jamal: Quick question — will feature teams be able to pin an older kernel/model variant during launches? We need that to reduce blast radius for product launches.

chris: Yes — we'll expose a model_variant pinning flag + routing policy in both API and Console. Teams can opt into pinning per-route.

maya: Action items recap: chris owns SLO thresholds + dashboards (due EOD Fri), anil owns canary/playbook (PR by Tue), eli PRs runbook (Weds), sophia publishes benchmark matrix (tomorrow). Any objections?

eli: no objections :+1:

sophia: noted — will include perf/cost tradeoffs and suggested defaults for feature teams.

maya: Thanks all. I'll post a condensed follow-up in the roadmap doc and tag the leads.

chris: Thanks — will share the dashboard template and a sample alert rule.

anil: Adding smoke test checklist to the ticket now.

maya: Closing the thread — reopen if anything changes. Thanks!
